_doc: Waivers for qa/layout-audit.mjs. Every entry MUST carry a reason. Waived hits are not deleted:
they are printed in the report as "waived" and counted, so the auditor never goes blind.
Fields: type (detector id, required), selector (CSS the offending element must match, required),
states (array of state-id prefixes, or ["*"] for all), reason (required, plain English).
A waiver is a promise that the hit is intentional AND accessible some other way — not a mute button.
SECOND KIND (round-1 verification, layout-safari): an ATTRIBUTED waiver. A state that HOSTS another
layer's screen reports that layer's defects as its own — the job stage mounts the study layer's card,
so every card-chrome hit lands on a job- state and fails the game layer's acceptance command
(`node qa/layout-audit.mjs --only job`, notes/J6.md). Such a hit may be waived ON THE HOSTING STATES
ONLY, and only when a CONTROL STATE outside the host reproduces it and is left UNWAIVED, so the owning
layer's net still fails on it. The reason must name that control. This is an attribution, not an
exemption: nothing is muted anywhere, it is moved to the state that owns it.
ROUND-2 VERIFY (test-integrity finding 6): an ATTRIBUTED waiver now carries a machine-checkable
`attribution` block — { control, measuredAt, command, hits[{type, selector, onHost, controlSelector?,
onControl}] } — and tests/job-audit-allow.test.mjs gates it on every `node --test tests/` run: the
control state must exist in qa/audit-states.mjs and be waived by nothing, the counts must be the ones
the named command produced, and when qa/audit/report.json is present and covers both sides, EVERY
waived hit in it must be enumerated here. Prose counts in a reason are how 47 findings went stale.

entries.reason: Header status read-outs. The readiness ring and the T-minus chip sit inside the 48px-tall #hdr-home / #/settings anchors, which ARE >=44px; the inner spans are decoration reported by the DOM as their own hit boxes.
Visually-hidden or aria-hidden text is never read on screen; its computed colour is meaningless.

ATTRIBUTED (see _doc): the card's SIDE RAIL — the hint ladder and the scratch toggle — sits below the card body, and with a 336px keyboard up on a 667px phone it cannot be scrolled clear of the dock. It is site/css/components.css's, not the job host's: the identical hits stand UNWAIVED on card-pairs-kb (#/card/ang-wu-1 with the same keyboard, no job anywhere). Counts re-measured 2026-09-22 from the run in `attribution.command` and carried in `attribution.hits` — 9 on .card-hint-btn and 7 on .card-scratch-toggle, the same on host and control. Gated by tests/job-audit-allow.test.mjs. Study-layer backlog: notes/repair-tests.md.

ATTRIBUTED (see _doc), and the heaviest of these — it is NOT a mute. The pairs widget's own text field starts below the lifted dock at 375x667 with the keyboard open, and widgets/base.js keepVisible() cannot scroll it clear because the widget's picker is taller than the band the keyboard leaves. It is the WIDGET's geometry, not the job's: card-pairs-kb reproduces `unreachable-answer input#wpairs-1-in` 8 times (re-measured 2026-09-22) with no job in the page and is left UNWAIVED, so the study layer's net fails on it exactly as it should. Owner: site/js/widgets/pairs.js + site/css/widgets.css. Gated by tests/job-audit-allow.test.mjs. Study-layer backlog: notes/repair-tests.md.
